how_to_add: Add an event or a year in this file only. No template change. One events object is one edition: slug, series (every year of that show uses the same series and the same name), name, year, past_name, start, end, timezone, url, source_url, source_note. On the company, add one history entry per edition: event (the edition slug), year, source (http or https URL of the exhibitor list for that year). source is required. CI rejects a missing, blank, or non-URL source. On and before the end date, in that timezone, the year stays highlighted: Exhibiting at {name} · {dates}. Years of the same series that have already ended share one line, most recent first: Exhibited at EP Shanghai 2026 · 2025. A show with one past year reads Exhibited at WETEX 2025. The next calendar day after the end date, the highlighted year joins that line. Sourced editions in this file are EP Shanghai 2026, Enlit Europe 2026, ADIPEC 2026, ENERGETICS 2026, ELECRAMA 2025, CIGRE GCC Power 2025, WETEX 2025, and Vietnam Energy Week 2025. Do not add a year that has no exhibitor list. Batch 3 adds Power Bangladesh 2023, CIGRE Symposium Heidelberg 2027, VDE Hochspannungstechnik 2026, JECA FAIR 2027, Electrical Expo 2026, ECCE Europe 2026, Power & Water Nigeria 2026, Power & Energy Kenya 2027, Power & Energy Tanzania 2026, Electric & Power Philippines 2026, and Power & Electricity World Africa 2026. Batch 4 adds exhibitor history for CWIEME Berlin 2026, Coiltech North America 2026, Coiltech Italia 2026, CIGRE Paris Session 2026, HANNOVER MESSE 2026, Middle East Energy 2026, Electra Mining Africa 2026, WETEX 2026, Data Center World POWER 2026, and SMRP 34th Annual Conference 2026.
